title: Running total of monthly sales
prompt: Using a CTE named monthly_sales that selects month and revenue from the sales8 table, write a query that uses this CTE together with a window function to return month, revenue, and running_total — where running_total is the cumulative sum of revenue ordered by month, computed with SUM(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month).
reference_sql: WITH monthly_sales AS (SELECT month, revenue FROM sales8) SELECT month, revenue, SUM(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month) AS running_total FROM monthly_sales;
